from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib
runtime=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
old_path=runtime/'requests'/'A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2.json'
old=json.loads(old_path.read_text())
req=json.loads(Path('control/model_execution/direct_requests/A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R5P1.json').read_text())
res=json.loads(Path('control/model_execution/direct_results/A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R5P1.json').read_text())
assert req['task_id']==res['task_id']=='A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R5P1'
assert req['binding_sha256']==res['binding_sha256']
assert req['input_sha256']==res['input_sha256']
assert req['candidate_id']==res['candidate_id']=='AUTO-DISCOVERY-54d13314c7879b58e46d'
assert req['campaign_id']==res['campaign_id']=='FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
assert res['model']=='gpt-5.6-sol' and res['model_display']=='GPT-5.6 Sol'
proposal=json.loads(res['final'])
assert proposal['proposal_version']==5
assert proposal['scientific_status']=='NO_PROVEN_EDGE'
assert proposal['safety']=={'live_trading':False,'paid_actions':False,'wallet_actions':False}
out=dict(old)
out['task_id']='A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261008-R5P1'
out['campaign_id']=req['campaign_id']
out['candidate_id']=req['candidate_id']
if 'route_task_id' in out: out['route_task_id']='SESSION-ROUTE-246799adf99f0bf8336c27a0'
# Replace only the proposal payload inside the proven template prompt.
prompt=str(old['prompt'])
marker='INPUT_JSON:'
assert marker in prompt
prefix=prompt.split(marker,1)[0]+marker
payload={'candidate_id':req['candidate_id'],'campaign_id':req['campaign_id'],'proposal_task_id':req['task_id'],'proposal_binding_sha256':req['binding_sha256'],'proposal_input_sha256':req['input_sha256'],'proposal_completion_sha256':res['completion_sha256'],'proposal':proposal,'scientific_status':'NO_PROVEN_EDGE','safety':{'live_trading':False,'paid_actions':False,'wallet_actions':False}}
out['prompt']=prefix+json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
out['input_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(out['prompt'].encode()).hexdigest()
if 'binding_sha256' in out: out['binding_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
assert out['phase']=='ASTRA_PREBUILD'
assert out.get('target_model','gpt-6-astra') in ('gpt-6-astra','GPT-6 Astra') or out.get('model_policy')=='ASTRA_EXACT'
assert out['live_trading'] is False and out['paid_actions'] is False and out['wallet_actions'] is False
dest=Path('control/dev_checks/r5p1_astra_request_candidate.json')
dest.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print('R5P1_ASTRA_REQUEST_CANDIDATE=PASS')
print('OLD_KEYS='+','.join(sorted(old.keys())))
print('TASK_ID='+out['task_id'])
print('INPUT_SHA256='+out['input_sha256'])
print('PROPOSAL_COMPLETION_SHA256='+res['completion_sha256'])
